searches.reason: Explore replacing fixed recency weighting with elapsed-time conditioning inside one jointly trained GRU4Rec. Timestamp-aware state updates could distinguish continuing activity from stale interests without assuming that time gaps reveal intent. Seek lightweight mechanisms and history-perturbation controls feasible within the fixed training budget.

searches.reason: Investigate whether weak Electronics margins reflect inadequate negative coverage or ambiguous negatives. Compare a sampled-softmax objective against BPR-max in controlled GRU4Rec experiments, separating sampling distribution, false-negative handling and score scale. Retain common diagnostic samples and select only through the pinned macro validation HR@10.

searches.reason: Explore jointly learning item representations from available titles and descriptions alongside interaction IDs within one GRU4Rec network, using a small text encoder trained from scratch. This could improve item specificity for sparse histories; seek evidence distinguishing useful complementary relationships from generic semantic similarity, without pretrained weights or separately fitted scores.
searches.query: content-aware GRU sequential recommendation jointly trained item title description encoder from scratch sparse items complementary versus substitute products 2023 2024 2025 2026
